explanation: `splitTraceCoverPolynomial` is defined in the library itself (TraceCurve/Geometry.lean). It is the bivariate polynomial `α·X₀^d·X₁^(2e) + β·X₀^d − X₀^(2d)·X₁^e − X₁^e`. The theorem says that with α = 1 and d = e = p, over a perfect field of characteristic p, this polynomial is not irreducible, because it is a p-th power. The proof only specializes another lemma of the same library. Mathlib has no statement about this particular polynomial. Getting the result from Mathlib's general facts would take real work: showing the polynomial is a p-th power (via Frobenius surjectivity on a perfect field) and then that p-th powers are not irreducible. That is more than routine glue, so no Mathlib declaration carries the content.
